description: Edit a post. A DRAFT can be changed freely by its author, an owner or an admin (body, media, overrides, first_comment, targets, scheduled_at, design, and png: the a reviewer marked 'Their OK publishes' may change only overrides (a per-account short copy), kind, and the texts inside the image (design_fields {variable key: text}, never a picture variable or caption; with its png) on someone else's post). design_fields works on posts made on a template only (a flat picture answers no_design); without png the old render leaves (needs_png + render in the answer). overrides is MERGED per account: send only the accounts you change, a key set to null removes that account's copy, overrides_replace: true replaces the whole map; rendered picture of its design as a data:image/png;base64 URL, which becomes the post's first picture). A SCHEDULED post can be edited only while status is 'scheduled' and more than 5 min before publish. Only the fields you send change; the project cannot be changed. Check status with viralhunt_get_post first; on a 409 error re-fetch instead of retrying.

assigned_to.description: Drafts and posts in review: the member who takes it over (a user id from viralhunt_members; agents count); null unassigns. Their board card, their notification. A trusted reviewer may assign on someone else's post. The answer carries the stage read back after the edit.

author_notes.description: Drafts: notes for the reviewer, never published (the source link goes here).

carousel.description: Only when the user asked for a carousel: allows several pictures in media. Without it a second picture answers 422 multiple_pictures. A post made on a template always has ONE picture, its render.

design.description: The filled template of this post (see viralhunt_schedule): send it to repair a post that went out with a PNG only, so its image becomes editable.

design_fields.description: Drafts made on a template: {variable key: corrected text} for the texts inside the image (text variables only, never caption). Send the new png with it when you can render.

overrides.description: Drafts: per network or per account id: body, media, first_comment, thread.

png.description: Drafts: data:image/png;base64,… of the rendered design; stored as the post's ONE picture (it replaces any picture the post had).

scheduled_at.description: New ISO-8601 UTC time (must be in the future).

name: viralhunt_update_post
